The '''TIE/rc vanguard''' was a variant of the [[TIE/rc starfighter]] reconnaissance craft. Like the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]]/rc, it was a short-range ship based on the common [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] concept.

==Characteristics==
The physical differences between the TIE Vanguard and other TIE series [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were greater than those of the TIE/rc. Several large antennae connected to [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] arrays and communications equipment protruded from the cockpit ball, and the upper section of each [[Quadanium steel/Legends|Quadanium alloy]] solar ionization panel was shortened and swept outwards to reduce interference with the dorsal scanners.

As with the TIE/rc, weaponry consisted of a sole [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] that was placed on the chin of the cockpit ball; however, unlike its predecessor, the Vanguard was protected by limited [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]], thus enabling it to better protect any intelligence and other data that it had gathered.

==History==
The Vanguard was designed to perform scouting and intelligence-gathering missions, and was often deployed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in order to obtain information on enemy [[Warship/Legends|warship]] or [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] movements prior to a full fleet engagement. The type saw service with the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] as early as the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].
